messages:
Priya Kapoor: Hey folks :wave: AWS Marketplace listing needs the security artifact bundle for the Redwood Dedicated integration — SOC2, latest pen-test summary, and the vendor questionnaire. We also need a redaction/PSI plan for customer data. Who can own creating the upload bundle and presigned links?
Matthew Lee: I can take the bundle creation. timeline?
Priya Kapoor: Thanks Matt. Marketplace deadline is next Friday EOD. Ideally we upload by Wed to give them time to review.
Sarah Chen: I’ll scrub the pen-test report for customer IPs and internal hostnames. Will need redaction guidance and a reviewer. :lock:
Jason Ortiz: I can review redactions. Also we should include an inventory file listing each artifact + owner + retention TTL.
Priya Kapoor: Perfect. Inventory format suggestion (very small):
```
artifacts.json
- soc2_report.pdf — owner: Legal - Marketplace — retention: 3y
- pentest_summary_redacted.pdf — owner: Security Eng — retention: 1y
- vendor_questionnaire_filled.xlsx — owner: Partnerships — retention: 2y
- infra_diagrams_redacted.pdf — owner: Eng-Infra — retention: 1y
```
Priya Kapoor: For presigned links, S3 + 7 day expiry should be OK. Use the evidence-bucket with path /marketplace/redwood-dedicated/<date>/ — please set ACL: private.
evidence-bot: Upload token created: presign-01GZQYX. Links expire in 7 days. :robot_face:
Matthew Lee: Quick checklist for redaction so we stay consistent:
- Remove customer names and tenant IDs
- Mask internal IPs to 10.0.x.x format
- Strip auth tokens, cert private keys
- Replace full hostnames with service-role labels (e.g., db-primary)
Sarah Chen: FYI pen-test vendor flagged two default creds on a staging build (fixed). I’ll annotate the summary with mitigation steps and include the ticket numbers.
Jason Ortiz: Re: approval — @Legal - Marketplace, can you confirm SOC2 PDF can be included as-is or we need an attestation letter instead?
Legal - Marketplace: You can include the SOC2 PDF. Add a short attestation note that no customer data is disclosed in the report and point to the redaction checklist we used. I’ll sign the attestation.
Priya Kapoor: Great — Matt can you assemble the zip with artifacts, inventory JSON, attestation.txt, and a short README for reviewers? Name the zip: redwood-dedicated-marketplace-evidence-<yyyymmdd>.zip
Matthew Lee: On it. ETA Tuesday morning. I’ll post presigned links here when uploaded.
Priya Kapoor: One more thing — Marketplace reviewers sometimes ask for screenshots of the deployment console and a sanitized pricing config. Add those if you have them.
Sarah Chen: I have sanitized infra screenshots. Adding now.
Matthew Lee: Uploaded and generated presigned links: https://s3.wasabisys.example/presign/abc123 (expires in 7 days) — will DM the vendor contact the signed bundle link.
Priya Kapoor: Thanks — leaving action items:
- Matthew: assemble zip + upload + presigned links (due Tue AM)
- Sarah: redaction + annotate pentest (due Mon EOD)
- Jason: redaction review + inventory validation (due Tue AM)
- Legal - Marketplace: attestation signature (due Tue AM)
Priya Kapoor: Ping me if any blockers. :white_check_mark:
